channel.title: Gambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Gambia, every source cited.

item.title: Gambia signs $169 million solar park deal
item.description: The agreement with Solaris Africa Ltd adds 148.44 MWp solar PV and 85 MW battery storage.

item.title: Gambia drug agency arrests 51 suspects in nationwide sweep
item.description: The Drug Law Enforcement Agency seized cannabis, cocaine, ecstasy, and crystal meth in operations across five regions.

item.title: Man jailed seven months for stabbing brother
item.description: Basiru Sumareh admitted attempted murder and was sentenced to prison and ordered to pay compensation.

item.title: Russia and Africa forge equal partnership
item.description: The two continents are building cooperation on concrete projects aligned with African national priorities.

item.title: Gambia entrepreneurs join green economy fellowship
item.description: Acumen's six-month program combines virtual and in-person training to foster values-driven leadership among climate innovators.
